business_problem: OXIO needed a scalable way to centralize streaming telecom and application data so it could deliver fresher subscriber analytics, brand intelligence, and churn models without high ingestion latency or custom monitoring overhead.
solution_summary: OXIO uses Snowflake as the central data layer for its telecom-as-a-service platform, bringing subscriber, connectivity, and application data into one governed foundation for client analytics and data products. Streaming and batch telecom data are ingested through Apache Kafka into Snowflake, where dbt-ready modeling and built-in monitoring reduce the burden of keeping pipelines current. Data scientists use the unified data to build churn models and other AI/ML workflows, while client-facing reporting surfaces telecom and brand insights such as connectivity quality, wireless spend, engagement, and movement patterns. OXIO's BrandIQ offering sits on the same foundation to convert mobile-signal and behavioral data into privacy-centric intelligence for brands. By centralizing storage, modeling, and analytics in Snowflake, OXIO improved runtime performance, cut ingestion latency, and created a base for future sharing through client-owned Snowflake environments and Snowpark-enabled workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Stores unified subscriber, connectivity, and application data that powers OXIO analytics and AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Apache Kafka
solution_components.role: Streams large volumes of telecom event data into the Snowflake environment for downstream analysis.

solution_components.name: dbt
solution_components.role: Shapes raw telecom data into reusable analytical models for dashboards, brand intelligence, and churn analysis.

solution_components.name: BrandIQ
solution_components.role: Serves privacy-centric brand analytics and behavioral insights built from the curated Snowflake data.

data_flow: Streaming telecom and application data are ingested through Apache Kafka into Snowflake, modeled with dbt, and surfaced through dashboards and BrandIQ. The same unified data also feeds AI/ML churn models and operational insights for OXIO clients.
business_outcome: OXIO doubled runtime performance, reduced data-ingestion latency by 20%, gave clients unified telecom and brand insights, and freed data scientists to deliver churn models and retention workflows faster.
metrics: 20% reduction in data ingestion latency vs. previous solution
architecture_clues: Snowflake monitoring replaced a custom monitoring system for warehouse capacity and pipeline health.
